hypothesis.control: Validated complete B@25 at sequence secondary scale 0.50 and Entity/semantic weights 0.30/0.70.
hypothesis.treatment: Change only sequence secondary scale to 1.0.
hypothesis.family: Sequence grid was fixed before new results: existing scale 0 endpoint, primary 0.50, and new 0.25 plus 1.0 points. New contrasts 0.25 versus 0.50 and 1.0 versus 0.50 receive Holm correction within metric and estimator.
hypothesis.expected_direction: Higher sequence scale may surface useful adjacent evidence or increase chronological noise; preserve favorable, null, or unfavorable results.
